name: Papua New Guinea
shortSummary: Papua New Guinea has hosted high-level Indian engagement including a 2023 FIPIC summit co-chaired with PM Modi, reflecting India's growing Pacific outreach amid competition with China for regional influence.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Papua New Guinea co-hosted the 2023 India-Pacific Islands summit.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
